meta.title: Pitchside — Run your football club from one place
meta.description: Pitchside is a football club management app: keep a squad database, rate players on technical, physical, tactical and mental skills, and design tactical plans on an interactive board.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to manage your squad and tactics.
auth.unavailable: The server is unreachable. Try again shortly.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your squad at a glance.
dashboard.noRanking: Rate players to see a ranking.
dashboard.noPlansHint: Design your first formation on the tactics board.

players.title: Players
players.inSquad: {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} in your squad

evaluation.title: Skill evaluation
evaluation.noSkills: No skills defined yet. Add some in the admin.

plans.title: Tactical plans
plans.subtitle: Every board your staff has saved.
plans.noneHint: Save a board from the tactics page and it will appear here.

tactics.title: Tactics board
tactics.subtitle: Drag players, draw movements and save the plan.
tactics.hint: Pick a tool, then click or drag on the pitch. Double-click a player or text to edit it. Delete removes the selection; Ctrl+Z undoes.

footer.blurb: Squad management, player ratings and an interactive tactics board for football clubs.
footer.label: Footer

hero.title: Your squad, ratings and tactics in one place
hero.body: Pitchside replaces spreadsheets and screenshots. Keep every player on file, rate their skills after each session, and draw the game plan on an interactive tactics board.

features.title: Everything a coach needs between matchdays

squad.title: Squad database
squad.body: Profiles with contact details, club and photo. Search by name, city or club in seconds.

ratings.title: Skill ratings
ratings.body: Score players from 1 to 5 across technical, physical, tactical and mental skills and track the average over time.

board.title: Tactics board
board.body: Drag players, draw runs, passes and dribbles, mark zones and load formations like 4-3-3 on four pitch layouts.

plans.title: Saved plans
plans.body: Store every board as a plan, filter by manager, reopen it later and export it as an image.

languages.title: English, German, Arabic
languages.body: The whole app is translated, including right-to-left layout for Arabic.

one.title: Add your players
one.body: Enter your squad once with their details and photo.

two.title: Rate their skills
two.body: After training, rate each skill from 1 to 5. The dashboard shows who is improving.

three.title: Draw the plan
three.body: Build the formation and movements on the board, save it and share the image with the team.

cost.a: Yes. Pitchside is free to use and runs on your own server with Docker.

who.a: Amateur and youth clubs, coaches and team managers who want one tool for squad data, player development and match preparation.

board.q: What can the tactics board do?
board.a: Place home, away and neutral players, balls, cones and goals; draw runs, passes, dribbles and zones; load common formations; undo and redo; export a PNG.

data.a: In a PostgreSQL database that you host. Nothing is sent to third parties.

languages.a: English, German and Arabic, including right-to-left layout.

cta.title: Plan your next match in minutes

featuresPage.intro: Pitchside covers the three jobs a coach repeats every week: knowing the squad, tracking development and planning the match.

squad.body: Keep every player's details in one searchable list.

points: Technical, physical, tactical and mental categories

Home, away and neutral players with editable numbers
Runs, passes, dribbles, zones, text, balls, cones and goals
Undo, redo, delete and PNG export
